Sharp triangular beak pointing forward to the upper right
High vertical primary wing blade tapering upward toward the top border

shape.summary: A stylized low-poly swallow totem with an arched breast, swept wing fins, sharp beak, and coiled spiral eye.

legend.R: raised ground (plateau, one or more blocks above G)

composition.mass: Concentrates strongly in the center-right and upper-center where the elevated wings and cranium dais overlook the curving body.
composition.read: The viewer enters at the lower-left tail tine, follows the wide sandy arc of the belly sweep upward and rightward, passes through the threshold arch, and arrives at the raised focal head dais.

lighting.notes: burnt-umber graphite haze across cream vellum: Reflects the high-key cream paper background (#bfbeb7 to #ccccc9) contrasted with dense burnt-umber outlines (#3f2723).

rules: Keep the central belly floor wide and unobstructed to preserve the aerodynamic sweep.
Cluster tall wing spines strictly along the highest northern plateau ridge.
Place contour fences along southern cliff drops to mark the drawing's outer boundary.
Leave surrounding void open to emulate unpainted drawing paper.

lens.aspect: Translates the sweeping aerodynamic contours and spiral eye vortex of the swallow directly into an elevated spiral flyway plateau.
lens.place: An aerodynamic updraft roost and wind-sculpted ridge overlooking open void.
lens.summary: The landform mimics the continuous calligraphic curve of a banked swallow, climbing inward along a coiled ridge toward the spiral head dais.
lens.differs: Unlike the parchment ribbon of the medium reading or the masonry flyway of the subject reading, this level sculpts the entire island as a winding stepped updraft spire coiled tightly into the focal head spiral.

concept.name: lens-composition
concept.fragment: LENS "composition": the drawing's STRUCTURE becomes the terrain literally. Start from ANALYSIS.composition. The main mass becomes the highest land, placed where it sits in the frame; the flow lines become the path and the ridges, running the same way; the negative space becomes void (bays and gaps cut into the island) or open ground; symmetry or its absence decides "symmetric" versus an asymmetric shaper; scale cues decide how big the figure stands against the land. Choose the shaper and its params as a transcription: peak, center, from, ratio, split, turns and hand must be read off the frame positions in the analysis (x left to right 0..1, z top to bottom 0..1). Map picture to plan this way: the top of the frame is the far rim (row 0), the bottom is the near rim (row 11). Lighting follows ANALYSIS.palette.value_structure: where the lights and darks fall becomes where sun and shadow fall, and a high-key or low-key picture sets ambient. The figure stands at the focal point and its pose repeats the drawing's main gesture line. Palette follows the value map: the surfaces are ranked by value as the picture's areas are (the emptiest area becomes the palest surface, the densest the darkest), with the piece's accent hue kept for the focal point and its threshold. Props mark the structure: posts along a flow line, a gap where the negative space opens, a counterweight at the second mass.
